rows.text: The Assembly's profile of Lord Tu'ilakepa, dated 15 September 2010, states that he was re-elected as a Vava'u nobles' representative in the 2008 General Elections and 'was appointed Speaker of the Parliament of Tonga the same year'; its 'PARLIAMENT HISTORY' list includes 'Appointed Speaker of House, 2008'.
rows.locator: Profile paragraph 2 and the 'PARLIAMENT HISTORY' list
rows.uncertainty: Appointment year only; no appointment instrument or release was found. Government-published records attest him in office on 2 June 2008 and 29 June 2010 (to_speaker_tuilakepa_reply_signed_20080602, to_speaker_tuilakepa_presides_20100629). The profile does not say he was still Speaker on 15 September 2010.
